mapper.select: SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectFileUldListByAsmtSnAndPtcpInstSn */ pst_sn , atch_file_id , uld_task_se_cd , file_se_cd , ptcp_inst_sn , del_yn , rgtr_id , reg_dt , mdfr_id , mdfcn_dt FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_file_uld WHERE pst_sn = #{pstSn} AND ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} AND del_yn = 'N'

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectFileUldListByPstSnAndTaskAndFileSeCd */ u.pst_sn , u.atch_file_id , u.uld_task_se_cd , u.file_se_cd , u.ptcp_inst_sn , u.del_yn , u.rgtr_id , u.reg_dt , u.mdfr_id , u.mdfcn_dt , f1.file_id , f1.file_nm , f1.file_extn_nm , f1.file_sz FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_file_uld u LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT f.atch_file_id AS file_id , f.file_nm , f.file_extn_nm , f.file_sz FROM kids_own.tb_ca_e_file_trsm f WHERE f.atch_file_group_id = u.atch_file_id AND f.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY f.file_seq LIMIT 1 ) f1 ON TRUE WHERE u.pst_sn = #{pstSn} AND u.uld_task_se_cd = #{uldTaskSeCd} AND u.file_se_cd = #{fileSeCd} AND u.del_yn = 'N'

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectFileUldListByPstSnAndTaskAndFileSeCdAndInstId */ u.pst_sn , u.atch_file_id , u.uld_task_se_cd , u.file_se_cd , u.ptcp_inst_sn , u.del_yn , u.rgtr_id , u.reg_dt , u.mdfr_id , u.mdfcn_dt , f1.file_id , f1.file_nm , f1.file_extn_nm , f1.file_sz FROM kids_own.tb_cm_m_file_uld u INNER JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_MBR_INFO m ON u.rgtr_id = m.mbr_id INNER JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_EXPRT_INFO e ON m.mbr_no = e.mbr_no LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT f.atch_file_id AS file_id , f.file_nm , f.file_extn_nm , f.file_sz FROM kids_own.tb_ca_e_file_trsm f WHERE f.atch_file_group_id = u.atch_file_id AND f.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY f.file_seq LIMIT 1 ) f1 ON TRUE WHERE u.pst_sn = #{pstSn} AND u.uld_task_se_cd = #{uldTaskSeCd} AND u.file_se_cd = #{fileSeCd} AND e.brno = #{instId}

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectFileGroup */ atch_file_group_id , task_se_cd , task_se_trgt_id , use_yn , reg_dt , rgtr_id , mdfcn_dt , mdfr_id FROM kids_own.tb_ca_e_file_group_trsm WHERE atch_file_group_id = #{atchFileGroupId}

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectFileListByGroup */ atch_file_id , atch_file_group_id , file_seq , file_strg_path_dsctn , prvc_incl_yn , file_nm , file_extn_nm , file_cn , file_sz , crt_dt , use_yn , reg_dt , rgtr_id , mdfcn_dt , mdfr_id , srvr_file_nm FROM kids_own.tb_ca_e_file_trsm WHERE atch_file_group_id = #{atchFileGroupId} ORDER BY file_seq

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectFile */ atch_file_id , atch_file_group_id , file_seq , file_strg_path_dsctn , prvc_incl_yn , file_nm , file_extn_nm , file_cn , file_sz , crt_dt , use_yn , reg_dt , rgtr_id , mdfcn_dt , mdfr_id , srvr_file_nm FROM kids_own.tb_ca_e_file_trsm WHERE atch_file_id = #{atchFileId}

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectFileByGroupId */ atch_file_id , atch_file_group_id , file_seq , file_strg_path_dsctn , prvc_incl_yn , file_nm , file_extn_nm , file_cn , file_sz , crt_dt , use_yn , reg_dt , rgtr_id , mdfcn_dt , mdfr_id , srvr_file_nm FROM kids_own.tb_ca_e_file_trsm WHERE atch_file_group_id = #{atchFileGroupId} LIMIT 1

SELECT /* kr.or.kids.domain.cm.common.mapper.selectFileBySrvrFileNm */ atch_file_id , atch_file_group_id , file_seq , file_strg_path_dsctn , prvc_incl_yn , file_nm , file_extn_nm , file_cn , file_sz , crt_dt , use_yn , reg_dt , rgtr_id , mdfcn_dt , mdfr_id , srvr_file_nm FROM kids_own.tb_ca_e_file_trsm WHERE srvr_file_nm = #{srvrFileNm}
